train.prompt_description: original source-training GT box with 0..3 px jitter; worker RNG is fixed and cached once

dev.prompt_description: formal evaluation GT tight box; no jitter (used for stable quality-score calibration)

split_separation.rule: Exact (task, sample_id) intersection must be empty

selected_config.loss: MSE over all three returned candidate IoU labels

all_configs.loss: MSE over all three returned candidate IoU labels
MSE over all three returned candidate IoU labels
MSE over all three returned candidate IoU labels

selection.criterion: highest source-dev overall sample-average Dice from predicted-IoU argmax; task-macro Dice breaks an exact tie

acceptance.primary_selector: overall sample-average Dice; task-macro Dice resolves an exact overall tie
acceptance.material_task_regression_rule: delta tuned-quality minus fixed candidate 0 <= -0.02 Dice
acceptance.reason: tuned quality argmax exceeds fixed candidate 0 on both macro and micro validation Dice with no task-level decline of 0.02 or more

perturbation.definition: each xyxy coordinate receives an independently sampled deterministic uniform shift in ± level × original box width/height, then is clamped and kept non-degenerate
